name: Take and Hold mirror A - suggested deployment
intent: Wraiths and the Destroyer package start as far forward as their safe terrain positions allow. Both Wraith bricks and the Skorpekhs touch terrain for cover. Ammentar is forward beside the Skorpekhs for Lone Operative. The Nightbringer and Reanimator sit clear of, and behind, the blue home ruin. One Flayed One unit infiltrates behind the centre ruin without touching it; the second screens the right rear. The Void Dragon starts in deep strike.

nightbringer.note: Behind the south corner of the blue home ruin, not touching its footprint.

ammentar.note: Forward beside the Skorpekh package, using Lone Operative.

skorpekh-lord.note: At the front of the home ruin and attached to the Skorpekhs.

technomancer-veil.note: Attached to Wraith unit 1 in the open pocket of the left terrain area.

technomancer.note: Attached to Wraith unit 2 in the blue home ruin.

reanimator.note: Behind the south corner of the blue home ruin, not touching its footprint.

wraiths-left.note: Forward around the left terrain area with every Wraith base touching the footprint for cover.

wraiths-centre.note: Forward in the open middle of the blue home ruin, clear of its walls.

flayed-ones.note: Infiltrate behind the centre ruin without touching its footprint.

skorpekhs.note: Forward column along the right edge of the blue home ruin, touching the footprint for cover while staying clear of the wall.
